evidence.quote: Current and conditional candidate peaks follow.

CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation tied to identified content was found.

COD.rationale: Content (red cell coordinates) and separate organization/access metadata (origin entry) are both explicitly present for the same referent and time, satisfying C, O and D bindings.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing-condition statement is tied to a named content's organization/access.

C.rationale: The report lists explicit content tokens (color assignments to coordinate sets) with attributes (red/blue) and identifiable referents.

D.rationale: Content assignments are presented separately from origin/representation-status metadata for the same referent, distinguishing identification from organization/access status.

O.rationale: The report records explicit organization/representation/access metadata (origin entries) for identified content referents, describing how they are presented or derived.
